Mode: sheen: single-pass velvet sheen. shells: shell fur drawn with instanced copies of the geometry (set Instance Count to Shells on your Geometry COMP).
Fuzz: Roughness of the sheen lobe. Lower = tighter, more satin; higher = softer, wider.
Rimfuzz: Strength of the halo at grazing angles.
Pilepatches: Amount of large crushed-pile patches that vary the look.
Shells: Number of fur shells (instances) in shells mode. More = denser, slower.
Furlength: Length of the fur in object units (shells mode).
Density: Strand density in shells mode. Higher = more, finer strands.
Strandwidth: Thickness of each strand in shells mode.
Rootdark: Darkening toward the strand roots in shells mode. 0 = none.
Envrot: Rotates the studio environment lighting around the vertical axis, as a 0-1 fraction of a turn.
Envint: Intensity of the procedural studio environment lighting.
Modamount: Scale of the in1 modulation CHOP. 0 = ignore it.
Resolution: Output size in pixels of the internal preview render.
Bloom: Strength of the preview glow around bright areas.
Spinturns: Whole turns the preview geometry rotates per preview cycle.
Tilt: Tilt of the preview torus knot in degrees.
Camdist: Preview camera distance in world units.
